RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT (Connecticut) — synthetic test fixture (CLEAN)

1. Parties and Premises. This Lease is made between the Landlord and the Tenant for the residential premises located in Middletown, Connecticut.

2. Term. The term of this Lease is twelve (12) months, beginning September 1.

3. Rent. The Tenant shall pay the monthly rent on the first day of each calendar month.

4. Security Deposit. The Tenant shall pay a security deposit equal to one month's rent. The deposit is refundable. The Landlord shall return the deposit, together with accrued interest, within twenty-one (21) days after the tenancy ends, less the cost of repairing any damage the Tenant causes.

5. Repairs and Habitability. The Landlord shall keep the premises in a fit and habitable condition and shall make the repairs needed to keep it so, including to the heating, plumbing, and electrical systems.

6. Entry. The Landlord may enter the premises only at reasonable times and after giving the Tenant reasonable advance notice, except in the case of a genuine emergency.

7. Utilities. The Tenant shall arrange and pay for electricity. The Landlord supplies heat and hot water.

8. Early Termination. If the Tenant leaves before the term ends, the Landlord shall make reasonable efforts to re-rent the premises at a fair rental so as to reduce what the Tenant may owe.

9. Quiet Enjoyment. The Tenant is entitled to the quiet enjoyment of the premises throughout the term.
